name: SearchUsers
maximal_sql:
SELECT
    u.id,
    u.email,
    u.status,
    u.created_at
FROM users AS u


JOIN organization_users AS ou
  ON ou.user_id = u.id
 AND ou.organization_id = $1

WHERE TRUE


AND (u.status = $2)


AND (u.email LIKE $3 || '%')


AND (u.created_at >= $4)


ORDER BY u.created_at DESC

LIMIT $5;
